answer: A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The violet counter is kept in bridge and shale reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 369 aliases cost 135 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
